trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move persists or is a thin-liquidity blip; compare to 2Y yield and Fed funds futures (SOFR strip) for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check with any macro headlines (payrolls, CPI, financial-stability event) that could justify a dovish repricing; verify TLT is tracking rates move.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether front-end rate futures corroborate the easing shift; watch for reversal if it was noise.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against equity/credit risk tone — recession-driven dovishness should coincide with risk-off; confirm direction still intact.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. thesis; note whether the prob move was information (sustained) or noise (mean-reverted).

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 8 rate cuts (200bps) in 2026 is an extreme dovish/recession tail. If its implied probability spiked sharply, it would signal expectations of an aggressive easing cycle — possibly emergency cuts tied to a growth shock or crisis. That flattens/lowers the expected policy path, pulling front-end yields down and, with a bull-flattening bias, boosting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid duration proxy.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the probability move is real; check DXY and EURUSD reaction alongside rate futures.
time_plan.1h: Determine whether the dovish repricing is growth-scare (USD-supportive haven bid) or benign disinflation (USD-negative) to resolve directional ambiguity.
time_plan.2h: Watch relative moves vs. other central-bank pricing (ECB, BoE) to gauge differential story.
time_plan.6h: Reassess risk sentiment; if broad risk-off, downgrade the dollar-down thesis.
time_plan.12h: Record UUP outcome and flag the directional ambiguity as a lesson for the proxy mapping.

predictions.reasoning: An abrupt jump in the probability of 8 Fed cuts implies a sharply lower expected US rate path relative to other central banks, which typically weakens the dollar via narrowing rate differentials. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Confidence is lower because a recession-driven easing scenario can trigger safe-haven USD buying, offsetting the rate-differential effect — the sign is genuinely ambiguous.

evidence_used: Market question targets 8 cuts (200bps) in 2026 — an extreme dovish tail including emergency cuts
Standard macro linkage: dovish Fed repricing lowers yields (bonds up) and narrows rate differentials (dollar softer)
TLT and UUP are highly liquid proxies for duration and USD respectively
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradable threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these liquid proxies, so neither is 'tradable' by the stated bar
Direction of the dollar is ambiguous: recession-driven easing can spark safe-haven USD strength, contradicting the rate-differential logic
A move in this specific Polymarket contract may reflect thin liquidity/speculation rather than genuine information leakage
No timestamp of an actual anomaly is given — this is a forward mapping, not a reaction to a confirmed spike

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 8 Fed rate cuts in 2026 encodes an extreme dovish/recession-tail repricing of US monetary policy. The cleanest downstream implications are lower US yields (long Treasuries / TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down), though the dollar sign is confounded by potential safe-haven flows if the easing is growth-scare driven. Expected 12h magnitudes are modest (tens of bps) and well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so these are low-confidence research mappings, not actionable signals.
key_assumptions: A jump in the market's implied probability reflects genuine shift in Fed easing expectations, not noise
Standard transmission: dovish repricing lowers yields and pressures the dollar
TLT and UUP maintain their normal sensitivity to rate expectations over the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move is thin-liquidity noise on a low-volume Polymarket contract and reverses within hours
Information is already public (e.g., dovish Fed speak or data already reflected in rates), so no asset move follows
Recession-driven easing triggers safe-haven USD buying, reversing the dollar-down call
Aggressive cut expectations coincide with risk-off that pushes long yields up on fiscal/supply fears, breaking the TLT-up link
Magnitudes far below the 700bps threshold mean any 'signal' is economically negligible
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
